question: From visible SHOPAPP foreign-key metadata, list every child table/column and referenced parent table/column. Explain the two-hop ORDER_LINES-to-CUSTOMERS chain and the separate PRODUCTS link.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT c.table_name,cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY c.table_name,cc.position

question: For SHOPAPP.ORDER_LINES, identify the primary-key constraint, its backing index and each indexed column in position order. Explain why this does not establish a leading-column index for PRODUCT_ID.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT c.constraint_name,c.index_name,ic.column_position,ic.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_ind_columns ic ON ic.index_owner=c.index_owner AND ic.index_name=c.index_name WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.table_name='ORDER_LINES' AND c.constraint_type='P' ORDER BY ic.column_position

question: From SH metadata list all SALES foreign-key columns and referenced parent tables/columns. Explain how to reach country names from SALES using declared relationships, without joining SALES directly to COUNTRIES.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SH' AND c.table_name='SALES' AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY cc.column_name
